verdict.rationale: Convex has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. It enables natural-language operation through external coding agents: it ships an official MCP server that lets agents act on a deployment, with production access blocked by default. It also provides an agent setup prompt and documents that you can start a project by asking your agent to create a Convex app. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface (e.g., in the dashboard or CLI), detailed documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
